operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) There is established the President's Drug Advisory Council in the Federal Government. The Council shall be composed of not more than 30 members appointed by the President from among citizens in private life.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 269073; common-crawl capture 2025-11-11T02:31:56Z; Sec. 1(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) The President shall designate a Chairman from among the members of the Council.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 269073; common-crawl capture 2025-11-11T02:31:56Z; Sec. 1(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) The Council shall recommend to and advise the President and the Director of National Drug Control Policy on developing methods and means to explain national drug control policies to the American people.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 269073; common-crawl capture 2025-11-11T02:31:56Z; Sec. 2(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) The Council shall recommend to and advise the President and the Director of National Drug Control Policy on promotional efforts to encourage the private sector to implement national drug control policies.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 269073; common-crawl capture 2025-11-11T02:31:56Z; Sec. 2(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (c) The Council shall study the feasibility of establishing a national support organization to help coordinate private sector initiatives to implement national drug control policies, and, in consultation with the President and the Director of National Drug Control Policy, shall provide advice to assist in the establishment of such support organization.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 269073; common-crawl capture 2025-11-11T02:31:56Z; Sec. 2(c)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (d) The Council shall meet with and solicit the advice of various members of the media and communications field, and, in consultation with the President and the Director of National Drug Control Policy, shall provide advice in coordinating efforts of the private sector to inform the public of the dangers of illegal drug use.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 269073; common-crawl capture 2025-11-11T02:31:56Z; Sec. 2(d)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (e) The Council shall devise means to solicit the views and advice of the American people regarding the development and implementation of national drug control policy. In consultation with the President and the Director of National Drug Control Policy, the Council shall utilize forums and seminars in various regions of the country to assist in this function.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 269073; common-crawl capture 2025-11-11T02:31:56Z; Sec. 2(e)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (f) The Chairman of the Council shall report to the President and the Director of National Drug Control Policy, whenever requested.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 269073; common-crawl capture 2025-11-11T02:31:56Z; Sec. 2(f)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) Members of the Council shall serve without compensation.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 269073; common-crawl capture 2025-11-11T02:31:56Z; Sec. 3(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) Members of the Council may be allowed travel expenses, including per diem in lieu of subsistence, as authorized by law for persons serving intermittently in Government service -5707).

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 269073; common-crawl capture 2025-11-11T02:31:56Z; Sec. 3(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (c) The Office of National Drug Control Policy shall provide administrative staff support to the Council, to assist in its day-to-day operations.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 269073; common-crawl capture 2025-11-11T02:31:56Z; Sec. 3(c)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (d) To the extent permitted by law, the heads of executive departments and agencies shall provide the Chairman of the Council, upon request, with such information as the Chairman may require for the purposes of carrying out the Council's functions.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 269073; common-crawl capture 2025-11-11T02:31:56Z; Sec. 3(d)
